column1: # The docs site's URL list (OW Infra #81) · created 2026-10-08 11:51 by Kael
# One list, read by two gates: Kael's build gate (before the switch) and Boss's /fleet check (live, every sweep).
# Built by scanning the tracked files of every repo under Development/OnlyWorlds for onlyworlds.github.io URLs, plus every page of the current site from its source tree.
# class: load-bearing = linked from outside the site or from the LLM guide: the path must serve the real content, 200, same host, never a stub.
#        page = a current page nothing outside links to: a stub redirect is enough if it moves.

# A 'template' row is a pattern: #{code} is any error code keel emits. The 'floor' rows are keel's own list of public codes (Error.x-ow-error-codes in its OpenAPI, Keel #82, vendored as contract/error-codes.json), written by scripts/gen_errors.mjs: each must be an anchor on /api/errors/. Don't edit floor rows by hand.
# status = the live .io today, redirects not followed. A 404 here was already broken before any migration.
